name: PlasmaGradient
description: A raw WebGL plasma shader: three domain-warped fbm iso-contours glow as hyperbolic electric filaments with white-hot cores over a near-black field, finished with an adjustable vignette. Falls back to rotating masked CSS arcs when WebGL is unavailable.
a11yNotes: The canvas (or CSS fallback) is an aria-hidden decorative layer; children render above with light, shadowed text. Animation stops off-screen, at speed 0, and under prefers-reduced-motion (one static frame). GL resources are deleted on unmount and a lost context switches to the CSS fallback.

propsApi.name: scale
propsApi.description: Size of the plasma structures; higher = larger, calmer arcs (0.3–3).

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the background in px.

propsApi.name: children
propsApi.description: Content rendered centered on top; defaults to a heading and subline.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
